about: fk-wizard's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk7-day-trip-packs
mutants.from:
case (Plan as p, Continue):
		if p.Overnight {
mutants.to:
case (Plan as p, Continue):
		if p.Overnight || true {
mutants.rule: A day trip skips supplies going forward (law Wizard.DayTripsSkipSupplies).

mutants.name: fk7-day-trip-back-to-supplies
mutants.from:
case (Permit as p, Back):
		if p.Overnight {
mutants.to:
case (Permit as p, Back):
		if p.Overnight || true {
mutants.rule: A day trip skips supplies going back (law Wizard.DayTripsSkipSupplies).

mutants.name: fk7-file-without-leader
mutants.rule: Filing needs a leader named as well as the rules agreed (law ReviewGatesFile; the tour always names one).

mutants.name: fk7-filing-drops-allowance
mutants.rule: The filing keeps the allowance granted (law ReviewGatesFile).

mutants.name: fk7-cancel-misses-review
mutants.rule: Cancel leaves every open stage, review included (law CancelFromEveryOpenStep; the tour cancels from the plan only).

mutants.name: fk7-cancel-forgets-kind
mutants.rule: A cancel keeps the trip's kind (law CancelFromEveryOpenStep).

mutants.name: fk7-edit-clears-grant
mutants.to:
case NoCode, Granted:
			Stay[Stage]{Next: Review{..r, Pass: NoCode}}
mutants.rule: Editing the code keeps an allowance granted (law EditClearsOnlyARefusal).

mutants.name: fk7-code-case-sensitive
mutants.rule: A code parses in any case (law CodesIgnoreCaseAndSpace).

mutants.name: fk7-code-untrimmed
mutants.rule: A code parses with spaces around it (law CodesIgnoreCaseAndSpace; the tour's field is already trimmed).

mutants.name: fk7-filing-quick
mutants.rule: The office answers a second after the filing (law FilingTakesASecond).

mutants.name: fk7-filing-never-answered
mutants.from: Enter[Stage]{Next: Confirmed{Overnight: f.Overnight, Allowance: f.Allowance, ID: IDFor(f.Overnight)}}
mutants.rule: Some run confirms the permit (law Wizard.Confirms).

mutants.name: fk7-confirm-wrong-id
mutants.rule: The permit number follows the trip's kind (law FilingTakesASecond).

mutants.name: fk7-log-keeps-one-more
mutants.rule: The log keeps the newest twenty (law LogKeepsTheNewest; the tour shows only new lines).

mutants.name: fk7-ignored-ends-the-entry
mutants.rule: An ignored signal keeps the stage's entry, so the filing's timer runs on (case tour: a cancel while filing).

mutants.name: fk7-move-logged-as-ignored
mutants.rule: A transition is logged from, to and on what (case tour).
